recap.text:
Big Game From Aiden Ng Not Enough As Newport Select Gold 14U Fall To Kamiak
November 6, 2026 vs. Kamiak
Aiden Ng scored 11 points, but Newport Select Gold 14U still fell to Kamiak, 57-24, on Friday at Finn Hill Middle School.
Leading 15-13, Kamiak went on a 9-point run to pull further away. Leading 27-17, Kamiak went on a 15-2 run to pull further away.
Additional scorers for Newport Select Gold 14U included Kalden Sen (7 points), Harry Zhang (4 points), and Mason Huang (2 points).
Kamiak rebounded the ball well, collecting 39 rebounds.
Next up for Newport Select Gold 14U is a game at Eckstein on Saturday.
